book.name: Amatiu
book.title: Ib̠eb̠i Asu̠gbagba Ma̠ Agu̠o̠ Amatiu Age̠ Bho̠

content: A̠sidogh obom o̠d̠e̠ erogh bho̠
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s alo̠gho̠m opa̠n a̠sidogh a̠rogh a̠nigha̠ awa ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Irileghom ote̠nai̠ny agu̠b̠an o̠li̠le̠ma ola̠ a̠kokod̠ia̠n o̠d̠e̠ erogh a̠nigha̠ ma̠ o̠nyi̠ d̠o̠yo̠.
Sa̠ i̠na a̠ruom rob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ o̠gi̠ ka̠ obhelegi eb̠la̠ ogbo ya̠ u̠tu̠n o̠d̠e̠ erogh ulebh bho̠, ya̠a̠ awa i̠bho̠ro̠ghan d̠o̠ ma̠ oru.

“Sa̠ i̠na a̠puta̠ a̠ruom ipa̠n rob̠a̠ra̠motu, agba ma̠a̠, ‘I̠gba ma̠ enigha̠ ma̠ ogbo ya̠ ulebh bho̠ ma̠a̠: I̠bi̠ghe̠, ami̠ na̠ a̠kokod̠ia̠n ed̠ia̠n bho̠ amado̠n. Na̠ ogigh rodughuna̠ na̠ rovi i̠nu̠m d̠ami̠, sa̠ eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar bho̠ na̠ elegha̠n. Itue d̠a̠ o̠d̠e̠ erogh bho̠.’
“Ya̠a̠, awa ibhin d̠o̠ e̠tu̠o̠m abar, sa̠ iten i̠d̠u̠a; odi agi̠ d̠a̠ o̠si̠ d̠o̠yo̠, sa̠ uwed̠i agi̠ d̠a̠ esi a̠b̠ua̠ d̠o̠yo̠.
Sa̠ ipa̠n isibh rob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠, irughom i̠te̠i̠ sa̠ i̠ze̠gi̠ awa.
Sa̠ ologi o̠li̠le̠ma bho̠ a̠gurom, sa̠ a̠ruom ogbo e̠gham d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ o̠gi̠ ka̠ okunugi i̠ze̠gi̠ ma̠ a̠nwunom bho̠, na̠ o̠bhu̠gi̠ e̠ma d̠awa osoroni.
“Sa̠ i̠na agba a̠nigha̠ ma̠ rob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠a̠, ‘O̠d̠e̠ erogh bho̠ na̠ a̠lei, ya̠a̠ ogbo ya̠ ulebh bho̠ i̠bi̠gh ma̠ i̠kpe̠ d̠o̠ awa ma̠ oru.
Ebula̠ o̠ku̠a, i̠gi̠e̠ d̠a̠ reten bho̠, ma̠ elebh ko̠ni̠ko̠ni̠ ola̠ inyin u̠manana ma̠ oru d̠a̠ o̠d̠e̠ erogh bho̠.’

Sa̠ rob̠a̠ra̠motu bho̠ imite i̠gi̠ d̠a̠ reten bho̠ ka̠ ikokod̠i ma̠ ogbo ya̠ awa i̠manana bho̠, a̠d̠igh i̠karabh na̠ ib̠eb̠i a̠nwunom bho̠, sa̠ imuzo d̠a̠ obom ogbo otu erogh bho̠ i̠ro̠ d̠a̠ rakpata od̠e.
“Sa̠ o̠li̠le̠ma bho̠ a̠d̠igh okpon ogbo ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ rakpata od̠e bho̠, sa̠ abi̠gh o̠ni̠ ola̠ o̠lagha d̠o̠ ma̠ ibura̠ erogh e̠yal bho̠.
Sa̠ a̠pura̠n i̠na ma̠a̠, ‘A̠tologha̠n, anwa id̠ighi eka̠ a̠d̠igh esi onon, ma̠ ola̠ anwa onwuna̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ ibura̠ e̠yal erogh bho̠?’ Ya̠a̠ i̠na na̠ owuna̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ abar ola̠ o̠wo̠ran.

“Ebula̠ o̠ku̠a sa̠ o̠li̠le̠ma bho̠ a̠ruom rob̠a̠ra̠motu bho̠ ma̠a̠, ‘I̠bhad̠i̠ ma̠ a̠sike na̠ aru̠gu̠o̠ d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ enuwoghom i̠na ka̠ ed̠ighom d̠a̠ obom azi̠m. I̠se̠ esi ed̠i na̠ o̠ghi̠r ib̠ub̠ura̠ od̠i.’
“Ezin bho̠ ubhelegi ma̠ iya̠ ib̠uiy, ya̠a̠ ta̠ o̠so̠n o̠nyi̠ki̠kara a̠nwunom obhin.”

content: Otua̠ otua̠ ebhugh onigha̠ A̠siza̠
D̠a̠ igiel obha̠, sa̠ Rafarisi bho̠ i̠d̠u̠a ka̠ i̠mu̠gho̠nyan agu̠o̠ obhin d̠a̠ asu̠gbagba d̠o̠yo̠ o̠kpati̠ ob̠ol o̠yo̠.

Sa̠ awa iruom ogbo atu̠ghan d̠awa na̠ ita̠ E̠ro̠d ma̠ o̠gi̠ d̠o̠yo̠ ka̠ opura̠n ma̠a̠: “O̠ni̠ atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠, i̠yar ologhom ma̠ anwa na̠ amar a̠rugh d̠a̠ a̠gia̠ga̠i, sa̠ anwa na̠ atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ ma̠ eten ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ga̠i, anwa na̠ okpon d̠o̠ bebina̠ o̠ni̠ d̠a̠ a̠misigh, sa̠ anwa obhin d̠o̠ ma̠ imitia̠n o̠ni̠ atu̠o̠m abar.
Ebula̠ o̠ku̠a, gba ma̠ a̠nigha̠ i̠yar, anwa i̠bi̠gh eka̠? A̠sora̠n otua̠ otua̠-ebhugh onigha̠ A̠siza̠ ke̠re̠, bo̠d̠o̠ ka̠ na̠ osora̠n d̠o̠?”
Ya̠a̠, A̠zizo̠s abi̠gho̠m ipesi d̠awa sa̠ a̠fugh ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Sa̠ ibhelebhel, ere wa̠ inyin na̠ o̠d̠agi̠an ami̠ bho̠?
Ileriome ami̠ ma̠ okpoki otua̠ bho̠.”

content: Sa̠ awa imutiom a̠dinari̠.
Sa̠ i̠na a̠pura̠n awa ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Onon ka̠ a̠misigh ta̠ a̠nyen, sa̠ u̠ge̠ ma̠ a̠d̠ien ta̠ a̠nyen?”

content: Sa̠ awa i̠wo̠ran i̠na ma̠a̠, “A̠siza̠.” Ebula̠ o̠ku̠a, sa̠ a̠ruom awa ma̠a̠,

content.text: “O̠ku̠a a̠d̠ighi be̠le̠ni̠, inigha̠ ma̠ A̠siza̠ ma̠ ita̠ A̠siza̠, ma̠ enigha̠ ma̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ma̠ ita̠ A̠zib̠a̠.”

content: Agu̠o̠ awa i̠mu̠gho̠n o̠ku̠a bho̠, sa̠ awa ib̠a̠gha̠gha̠ i̠we̠le̠man i̠na iten i̠d̠u̠a.
Ipura̠n ya̠ igboloma̠ ma̠ ob̠etina̠ d̠a̠ omugh
D̠a̠ onin a̠d̠a̠ma̠ obha̠, sa̠ Rasadusi bho̠, ogbo ya̠ oma̠ra̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ ob̠etina̠ d̠a̠ omugh odi bho̠, i̠gi̠ ka̠ i̠te̠i̠ i̠na ipura̠n i̠na ma̠a̠,
“O̠ni̠ atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠, A̠mozizi agba ma̠a̠, ku̠gba ma̠ o̠ni̠ a̠mugh ya̠ na̠ o̠mar d̠o̠ ma̠ o̠nyi̠, umor bho̠ ta̠ a̠bhin ani̠ d̠o̠yo̠ b̠o̠ka̠ amar o̠nyi̠ a̠nigha̠ i̠na.
I̠se̠n bha̠ od̠ua̠l a̠rumor e̠ro̠ na̠ i̠yar, sa̠ o̠pu̠r bho̠ a̠bhin ani̠ ya̠a̠ na̠ o̠mar d̠o̠ ma̠ o̠nyi̠, sa̠ a̠mugh awe̠le̠man ani̠ d̠o̠yo̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ umor d̠o̠yo̠.
Sa̠ a̠mutuma̠ ma̠ o̠ku̠a ma̠ oleghemeni i̠wal bho̠ na̠ oleghemeni i̠sar bho̠ ka̠ ate̠i̠ d̠a̠ oleghemeni od̠ua̠l bho̠.
D̠a̠ ekunuguma̠ bho̠, sa̠ ani̠ bho̠ eka̠ a̠mugh.
O̠ku̠a ka̠, d̠a̠ ob̠etina̠ d̠a̠ omugh bho̠ ka̠ i̠na ta̠ aro̠ ma̠ ani̠ ta̠ a̠nyen, ma̠ agu̠o̠ eb̠la̠ od̠ua̠l awa na̠ ebhin i̠na bho̠?”
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s awo̠ran awa ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Inyin na̠ o̠ru̠an o̠pi̠e̠, ezin bho̠ inyin u̠mo̠gho̠yan d̠o̠ ma̠ a̠d̠ire e̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠, a̠d̠igh a̠limon ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠.
D̠a̠ ob̠etina̠ d̠a̠ omugh bho̠ o̠walan ilom bo̠, unigha̠nom d̠o̠ nyen anwi̠i̠nyan, kpe̠le̠me̠ni̠ a̠nwunom ta̠ e̠ro̠ ma̠ agu̠o̠ itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ ote̠nai̠ny bho̠.
Ya̠a̠, ya̠ igboloma̠ ma̠ ob̠etina̠ d̠a̠ omugh imumugh bho̠, inyin ta̠ osen d̠o̠ ma̠ iya̠ A̠zib̠a̠ agba a̠nigha̠ inyin bho̠ ma̠a̠,
‘Ami̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ta̠ Ebraham na̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ta̠ Azi̠ki̠ na̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ta̠ A̠zeko̠pu̠ ke̠re̠’
? I̠na A̠zib̠a̠ imumugh d̠o̠, ya̠a̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ta̠ ogbo ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ a̠ghud̠um bho̠.”

content: Igiel bho̠ o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom bho̠ i̠mu̠gho̠n i̠nye̠n bho̠, sa̠ ib̠a̠gha̠gha̠ ma̠ d̠a̠ a̠d̠ien atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ d̠o̠yo̠ bho̠.
Oloko wa̠ Abu̠gh a̠pu bho̠
Igiel bha̠ Rafarisi bho̠ i̠mu̠gho̠n ma̠ A̠zizo̠s na̠ a̠kpegi ma̠ aru̠nu̠ Rasadusi bho̠, sa̠ awa ikokod̠ia̠n ani̠.
Sa̠ odi o̠ni̠ atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ oloko bho̠, a̠pura̠n o̠d̠agi̠an o̠yo̠, ma̠a̠:
“O̠ni̠ atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠, oloko oken wa̠ abu̠gh a̠pu d̠a̠ oloko bho̠?”
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s awo̠ran i̠na ma̠a̠:

content.text: “ ‘Tula̠ne ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠oyom na̠ eb̠la̠ ekpo ologi d̠oyom, na̠ eb̠la̠ eloghoma̠n ozu d̠oyom, na̠ ebla̠ ologi d̠oyom.’
Onon o̠pu̠r oloko bho̠ sa̠ aro̠ ma̠ wa̠ abu̠gh a̠pu bho̠.
Oleghemeni i̠wal bho̠ od̠i ma̠ agu̠o̠ o̠pu̠r bho̠: ‘Tula̠ne ma̠ o̠ni̠etua̠n d̠oyom ma̠ agu̠o̠ ozu d̠oyom.’
Eb̠la̠ roloko bho̠ na̠ a̠riwil bho̠, u̠ke̠ri̠ d̠a̠ i̠wal roloko i̠nye̠n.”

content: Ipura̠n ya̠ igboloma̠ o̠ni̠ wa̠ amar Akrai̠st bho̠
Igiel bho̠ Rafarisi bho̠ ikokod̠ia̠n bho̠, sa̠ A̠zizo̠s a̠pura̠n awa ma̠a̠:

content.text: “Inyin na̠ o̠ru̠ru̠an eka̠ na̠ ogboloma̠ ma̠ Akrai̠st? I̠na ka̠ o̠nyi̠ ta̠ a̠nyen?”

content: Sa̠ awa i̠wo̠ran ma̠a̠, “O̠nyi̠ ta̠ A̠devidi.”
Sa̠ i̠na a̠pura̠n awa ma̠a̠:

content.text: “O̠ku̠a ka̠ ere wa̠ igiel E̠mu̠gh bho̠ a̠d̠igh A̠devidi bho̠ sa̠ a̠bhelegi I̠na ma̠a̠, ‘Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠’? Sa̠ a̠fugh ma̠a̠,
“ ‘Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ d̠ami̠:
“Ro̠ ma̠ a̠dila̠de d̠a̠ od̠iom agu̠o̠ d̠ami̠
tu̠tu̠n ami̠ ta̠ a̠soroni ma̠ ogbo o̠lo̠gi̠an a̠d̠ien d̠oyom a̠tenemeni ma̠ okpokpolom o̠gbam a̠sike d̠oyom.” ’
Ku̠gba ma̠ A̠devidi a̠bhelegi i̠na ma̠a̠, ‘Wa̠nwuna̠,’ ka̠ i̠na ta̠ a̠d̠ighi eka̠ aro̠ ma̠ o̠nyi̠ d̠o̠yo̠?”

content: Sa̠ o̠ni̠ ola̠ a̠rue ma̠ o̠wo̠ran o̠yo̠, bo̠d̠o̠ omula̠ opura̠n o̠yo̠ ma̠ abar na̠ o̠ro̠ d̠o̠, ob̠eton a̠d̠a̠ma̠ obha̠ o̠gi̠ d̠a̠ ed̠ia̠.
